name: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Tenshi no Hanabira Zome
original_name: その花びらにくちづけを 天使の花びら染め
source:
The eighth Sono Hanabira game, featuring the series' fifth couple.

While class representative Kirishima Shizuku has foreign exchange student Shitogi Eris under her wing, a faintly glowing love settles into her heart.
However, Shizuku, worried sick thinking her nagging personality landed her on her crush's bad side, actually gets a confession straight to her face from Eris?!
Shizuku: "D-D-D-Don't misunderstand! I-I-I don't feel anything at all for you! (etc)"

This is the romantic comedy of Shizuku, the tsundere Yamato Nadeshiko, and Eris, the cool, blonde foreign exchange student not afraid to show her feelings, and their flirtatious, madly-in-love-with-each-other yuri relationship.

[Translated from [url=http://fuguriya.sakura.ne.jp/se08.html]official website[/url] by Procyon of [url=http://vndb.org/p2642]Yuri Project[/url]]
translation:
《亲吻那片花瓣》系列第八作，讲述系列第五对恋人的故事。

班长雾岛雫一直照顾着外国留学生篠木爱丽丝，一份微微发亮的爱意也悄然落入她心中。
然而，雫担心得不得了，以为自己爱唠叨的性格已经让心上人讨厌，没想到爱丽丝竟当面向她告白？！
雫：“才、才、才别误会！我、我、我对你根本没有任何感觉！（下略）”

这是傲娇的大和抚子雫，与坦率表达感情、冷静而金发的外国留学生爱丽丝之间的浪漫喜剧。两人彼此深爱，展开了一段甜蜜调情的百合恋情。

[翻译自[url=http://fuguriya.sakura.ne.jp/se08.html]官方网站[/url]，译者为[url=http://vndb.org/p2642]Yuri Project[/url]的Procyon]
